explained.summary: A bare list of the worst kinds of character: dark, soft, stubborn, brutish, childish, stupid, false, coarse, deceitful, tyrannical. Marcus doesn’t explain it. It reads like a note to himself of the traits he wants to watch for and avoid, perhaps with the tyrant at the end as the particular danger for an emperor.
